label: Physics V.1 constrains the motion reading of persisting-subject change
note: Physics V.1, 225a34–225b3, eliminates generation and corruption from motion and restricts motion to change between affirmative termini. The bound claim supplies this necessary condition. The route needs the converse for its admitted changes: every ChangesBetween instance with LivesAt at both endpoints must suffice for MovedIn in the same respect. That sufficiency and the mapping from the route's predicates to the text's affirmative termini remain open.
